title: Usage does not settle the value question
text: Levie’s supplied post distinguishes compute consumption from useful results and says the answer depends on individual workflows. It is a useful challenge to an adoption dashboard: a rising activity line still needs an explanation of which business work improved.
qualification: Practitioner observations from selected enterprise conversations, not a representative survey or measured return-on-investment study.
